video_title: Birao sam između novca i NBA sna | X&O’s Chat

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on his decision to choose the NBA over the EuroLeague
quotes.excerpt: I had a lot of offers from the EuroLeague and they were very good offers. Do you want to chase your life or do you want to chase your dream?
quotes.quote: I had a lot of offers from the EuroLeague and they were very good offers. Do you want to chase your life or do you want to chase your dream? I chose to chase my dream.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Meni je NBA bio san. Imali smo dosta ponuda iz Evrolige i bilo je baš baš dobrih ponuda. Da li ćeš da juriš svoj život ili ćeš da juriš svoj san? Ja sam izabrao da jurim svoj san.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on learning to dunk in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: My coach asked me, why don't you dunk? I said, I don't think I can dunk. He said, try.
quotes.quote: My coach asked me, why don't you dunk? I said, I don't think I can dunk. He said, try. So I dunked with two hands, and I realized how good it was. I was looking at the rim, and I was like, wow, this is good.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Meni trener kaže, što ti ne zakucaš? Ja rekoh, pa ja mislim da ne mogu da zakucam. On kaže, probaj. I ja sad zakucam sa dve i sad se uhvatio za onu obruč, uhvatio se i digao sam se. Znaš ono, uhvatio sam se kao kao maltene se dižeš skroz gore i gledam, kao, u, kako je ovo dobro.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on his early basketball influences in Serbia
quotes.excerpt: I always loved volleyball. Back then it was Vanja Grbić, Nikola Grbić, Gerić, Đula Mešter, Vasa Mijić, and Miljković.
quotes.quote: I always loved volleyball. Back then it was Vanja Grbić, Nikola Grbić, Gerić, Đula Mešter, Vasa Mijić, and Miljković. We were watching them win world championships and Olympics. We were watching all that, and that hustle that Americans talk about was incredible.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ja sam uvek voleo odbojku. Meni je odbojka bila kao tad je bio Vanja Grbić, Nikola Grbić, Gerić, Đula Mešter, Vasa Mijić, Vasa Mijić i Miljković logično. Znači da da ne vodim sve, ali znali smo, gledali smo, igrali smo svetsko prvenstvo, olimpijadu, šta god nismo osvajali, sve sve one sa onaj hustle što kažu Amerikanci je bio neverovatan.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on his first time away from home for basketball
quotes.excerpt: That was the first time I was away from home, and I realized I wanted to play basketball.
quotes.quote: That was the first time I was away from home, and I realized I wanted to play basketball. I was tall, but there were many tall guys in that period who were physically jumping over me. I started when I was 12 or 13 years old.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Tad sam prvi put odvojio od kuće i shvatio sam da želim da se bavim košarkom. Pošto sam već počeo, bio sam visok, ali je bilo u tom periodu dosta visokih koji su fizički odskakali od mene. Znači ja sam počeo sa nekih 12, 13 godina da počnem da treniram. To je više od 12.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on his early days at Hemofarm
quotes.excerpt: I had the luck to be called by Zoran Savić and Zoran Đurković who were looking for young players.
quotes.quote: I had the luck to be called by Zoran Savić and Zoran Đurković who were looking for young players. Many of them came from the development center. I saw the faces, I saw the names, and I was trying to put it all together. It was a beautiful period.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Imao sam sreće, mi smo zvali, mi smo zvali jedan drugog, sad sam video sa mojim klincem, moj klinac trenira u Megi i došao je njegov sin iz RTC-a, je došao na probu u Megi. I onda sam ja vidim ovako čoveka, znaš ono vidiš facu, vidim nadimke kako su ga zvali i ja ovo gledam i sad pokušavam da setim svega te situacije.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on his first experience with NBA draft talk
quotes.excerpt: Everyone was better than me in basketball, and they started saying, you're going to the NBA one day.
quotes.quote: Everyone was better than me in basketball, and they started saying, you're going to the NBA one day. I had that going through my head, and one guy from Novi Sad protected me in that moment. He said, what are you saying, you're going to the NBA, of course.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Svi ti ljudi kao očigledno su bolji bili od mene u košarci, kao ti ćeš ići u NBA možda jednog dana. Ja sećam to mi prošlo kroz glavu i jedan momak iz Novog Sada da ga ne imenujem sad, on u fazonu tad me zaštitio u momentu. Kao šta ti zašto to kažeš, kao naravno da ćeš ići u NBA.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on the Hemofarm organization
quotes.excerpt: Miša Lakić made it all ideal, that the whole city lived from Hemofarm, from all those things.
quotes.quote: Miša Lakić made it all ideal, that the whole city lived from Hemofarm, from all those things. That was my vision, maybe I'm wrong, but I assume that 90% of people that that city lived from Hemofarm, from all these things that were happening, from all these games that were in Milenijum, from all these new halls.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Kako je to Miša Lakić napravio da sve to bude idealno, da ceo taj grad živi od Hemofarma, od svih tih stvari. To je neko moje viđenje, možda ja ne mogu ne mogu neko možda grešim, ali smatram da je 90% ljudi da taj grad živi od Hemofarma, od svih tih stvari koje su se dešavale, od svih tih utakmica koje su bile u Milenijumu, od svih tih novih hala.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on his first dunk and practice at Hemofarm
quotes.excerpt: I remember when I dunked for the first time. It was a counter, and we were at training.
quotes.quote: I remember when I dunked for the first time. It was a counter, and we were at training. And my coach said, why are you dunking? I said, I don't think I can dunk. He said, try. So I threw the ball, and I tried with one hand, and I tried with two hands, and I caught the zone and I dunked. I caught the zone and I lifted myself up.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Sećam se kad sam zakucao prvi put. Bila je kontra i mi smo na treningu bili i Ivan Jovanović Ica, sad se bavi pevanjem, ali je u fazonu ono, ono kao no look. Ovako mi baca, kao Teo ono što baca, tako da i ja u kontra, desna, leva, bum, prvo zakucavanje i ja gledam, u, kako je ovo dobro. E od tad sam počeo da zakucavam.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on his first call-up to the Serbian national team
quotes.excerpt: We started in the younger categories in Novi Bečej. Novi Bečej is a known place to all basketball players.
quotes.quote: We started in the younger categories in Novi Bečej. Novi Bečej is a known place to all basketball players, that's where the training camp was. It was Wednesday, and they would ask, how are you? Good, super. Where is dad and mom? They would ask. And I would say, they are at home.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Prvo počeli smo mlađe kategorije u Novom Bečeju. Novi Bečej je poznato mesto svim košarkašima, to je bio taj trening kamp. Bila je sreda, i oni bi pitali, kako si? Dobro, super. Gde je tata i mama? Oni bi pitali. A ja bih rekao, oni su kod kuće.

quotes.speaker: Boban Marjanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Boban Marjanović on the 2015 U19 World Championship final against the USA
quotes.excerpt: I remember playing against DeAndre Jordan, for example, among others. That was an interesting series.
quotes.quote: I remember playing against DeAndre Jordan, for example, among others. That was an interesting series. I remember that final against America. We lost in the group, we lost six points, and then that was it. There was Bizzly, Patrick Beverley, and DeAndre Jordan, Steph Curry, and Jahlil Okafor.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Sećam se da sam igrao protiv DeAndre Jordana, na primer, između ostalog. To je bila jedna interesantna serija. Sećam se tog finala protiv Amerike. Izgubili smo u grupi, izgubili smo šest poena, i onda je to bilo to. Bilo je Bizzly, Patrick Beverley je bio tad, DeAndre Jordan, Steph Curry, Jahlil Okafor.

We were at 3-1, and Ivan Jovanović Ica was singing.
